title: Training Notes on the Patient Hardship Discount Program: One Determination per Charge and Household Coverage
content:
Only one approved Patient Hardship Discount Program determination applies to a charge: the one whose effective date to expiry date contains the charge's visit date. A renewal approved before the current expiry takes effect on the day after that expiry date. Discounts under two determinations never stack on the same charge, and where the level covers dependents, the determination covers dependents in the applicant's tax household as one household.

## Questions answered

**Q. A charge is presented for discount. Which determination governs it?**
A. The single approved determination whose period, from its effective date through its expiry date, contains the visit date of that charge.

**Q. When does a renewal approved before the current determination expires begin to apply?**
A. On the day after the current expiry date. The two periods therefore meet without overlapping.

**Q. Can one charge carry a discount under the current determination and another under a renewal?**
A. No. Discounts under two determinations never stack on the same charge.

**Q. Are the charges of the applicant's dependents covered?**
A. Where the determination's level covers dependents, the determination covers the dependents in the applicant's tax household, and the household is treated as one household under that determination.

## Worked timeline (hypothetical dates)

A current determination runs from an effective date of 2026-01-12 to an expiry date of 2026-07-11. A renewal is approved on 2026-06-25, before that expiry.

| Visit date of the charge | Determination whose period contains it |
|---|---|
| 2026-07-11 | The current determination (its expiry date) |
| 2026-07-12 | The renewal, which takes effect on the day after the current expiry date |

Each of the two charges is discounted under one determination only.
